rationale: The existing deterministic Help engine remains the source-grounded availability, next-step, alias, and catalog authority. MTH-40 closes the pinned entrypoint plus four catalog/module resources, prepares typed file-read, process, web, and model plans through the generic runtime seam, and binds the prepared exact invocation to the established durable MethodSessionService. Remote module documentation and open-ended answers remain host-reviewed adaptations, so support is adapted rather than exact.
